title: Coordinatewise Shamir scheme
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\iota$ be an index type. The vector-valued scheme shares a secret $v\colon\iota\to F$ using randomness that assigns to each coordinate a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$, applying the Shamir scheme separately in each coordinate. Given a finite set of parties and their share vectors, it reconstructs the secret coordinate by coordinate using the Shamir reconstruction map.
